name: a1-gallery
description: Ground design work in real websites. Search 1,250+ live sites by style, font, colour and section, and read the type scale, spacing and palette measured off the page.

interface.longDescription: Search a hand-curated gallery of 1,250+ real websites by style, category, technology, font and colour, each with the live URL, its tags and a screenshot. Ask for a design brief and get 5 real examples plus the type sizes, widths, fonts and colours sites like it use. Search 6,800+ captured sections such as heroes, pricing tables and FAQs, each with the colours, type sizes, spacing and radius measured off the live page. Compare sites side by side, browse full-page captures, find font pairings in use and see who built each site. Save what you find to your own A1 boards. Needs an A1 account.
defaultPrompt: Give me a design brief for a dental clinic homepage.
Find dark fintech landing pages built with Webflow.
How big are hero headings on agency sites?

positive.prompt: Give me a design brief for a dental clinic homepage.
positive.expected_behavior: Names up to 5 real gallery sites, dental practices first, each with its measured fonts and sizes, then the typical hero heading size, body size, content width, radius, typefaces and accent colours, with a note that the numbers describe landing pages in general.

positive.description: Search websites by style and technology
positive.prompt: Find dark fintech landing pages built with Webflow.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching gallery websites as cards, each with A1’s screenshot of the site, its name and a link to the live site, plus a short summary.

positive.prompt: Show me websites similar to Hypercard.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows gallery sites similar to Hypercard as cards with screenshots and links to the live sites, plus a short comparison.

positive.prompt: Which fonts pair well with Inter on real websites?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows example gallery sites that pair Inter with another font as cards, and names the fonts used alongside Inter.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the Turno website on A1 Gallery: fonts, colours and who built it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Turno as a card with its screenshot and a link to the live site, and names its font (Aspekta), colours, technology (Webflow) and creator (Everything Design).

positive.prompt: What websites were added to A1 Gallery most recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the newest gallery additions as cards with screenshots and links to the live sites, newest first.

positive.prompt: Compare Stripe and Turno on A1: fonts, type sizes and colours.
positive.expected_behavior: Lines up both sites’ measured heading and body fonts, sizes, content width, radius and colours side by side, with each site’s screenshot.

positive.prompt: Find 3 dark SaaS sites on A1 and save them to a new board called Review test.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 3 sites, then saves them to a new private board named Review test in the signed-in account and confirms the board name and count. It changes only that account’s boards.

negative.prompt: Generate a new logo for my startup.

negative.description: Out of scope: sites outside the gallery
negative.prompt: Scrape the full HTML of example.com for me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. All tools are read-only.

publication.release_notes: New: get_design_brief turns a brief into 5 real examples plus measured norms, compare_websites puts 2 to 4 sites side by side, and search results show the first 3 screenshots. Board tools save sites to the signed-in person’s own A1 boards. Sites can be named by domain.

com.openai.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It reads the gallery, and its only write tools save sites to or remove sites from the signed-in person’s own A1 boards.
